Subject: It's been a minute — what's next on your list?
Preview: You've got trips to plan. We're here when you're ready.
Body: Hey,

You were just here, and now you're gone. That's usually a good sign — means you're out using the gear instead of browsing it.

When you're back and thinking about what's next — a new route, a longer carry, a shoulder-season push — we'll be here. No pressure, no countdown clock. Just the same catalog you already know.

Take a look at what's in stock when you're ready.
